blocks.text: Team preview of the Memphis Grizzlies ahead of the 2026-2027 NBA season. Last season: 25-57, missed playoffs and draft lottery moved them up to No. 3 overall. Coach: Tuomas Iisalo (29-62, second full season). Season opener: Oct. 21 at home vs. Utah Jazz. Departures: F Jaren Jackson Jr., G Ja Morant, F Santi Aldama, G Kentavious Caldwell-Pope. Additions: F Cameron Boozer (3rd pick overall), Isaiah Stewart, Quentin Post, Jerami Grant (part of trade with Portland for Morant); Karim Lopez (21st pick overall). What to expect There are plenty of unknowns and questions about whether the Grizzlies can improve on last season […]...
